responsibilities.name: Scheduled Harness Evolution and Benchmark Cycle
responsibilities.instruction: Run a scheduled Paraclete-H2 evaluation and evolution cycle across Stage 1 and Stage 2 benchmark suites. Diagnose four-lens bottlenecks, run bounded evolutionary iterations, verify promotion gates, and record winning patterns in the pattern library.
responsibilities.success_criteria: Surface validation passed, Stage 1 and Stage 2 benchmark suites were evaluated across multiple trials, four-lens bottlenecks were diagnosed, candidate iterations were scored against the baseline, and a promotion report was emitted with explicit gate verdicts.

context.purpose: Continuous dual-loop harness optimization keeps capability and pass@k reliability climbing while driving token, turn, and cost overhead down across every role.
process: STEP 1 - VALIDATE: run `harness-cycle --action validate --repo . --json` to confirm the checkout respects all immutable spine boundaries and contract bounds.

STEP 2 - DIAGNOSE: run `harness-cycle --action diagnose --stage stage1 --trials 2 --json` and `harness-eval --action evaluate --stage stage2 --trials 2 --json` to rank bottlenecks across Context, Sub-Agents, Tools, and Scaffolding.
STEP 3 - EVOLVE: run `harness-cycle --action run --stage stage1 --iterations 3 --candidates 2 --trials 2 --json` to evaluate single-lens candidate mutations and update the pattern library.
STEP 4 - VERIFY PROMOTION GATES: run `harness-promote --action verify --repo . --stage stage1 --trials 2 --json` and `harness-promote --action report --repo . --stage stage1 --trials 2 --json`.
context.prior_learnings: Always isolate each candidate iteration to a single primary lens so capability, reliability, and efficiency deltas can be cleanly attributed. Never promote a candidate with a capability regression on any benchmark task.

responsibilities.name: Scheduled Failure Trajectory Harvest
responsibilities.instruction: Harvest recent failed or retried execution trajectories into sanitized regression benchmark fixtures and diagnose their primary four-lens bottleneck.
responsibilities.success_criteria: Recent failed trajectories were inspected, PII and secrets were scrubbed, replayable benchmark task fixtures were emitted, and the primary lens bottleneck was recorded.

context.purpose: Every production or canary failure becomes a permanent regression fixture so the harness never repeats the same failure mode twice.
process: STEP 1 - HARVEST: run `harness-eval --action harvest --stage all --json` to extract sanitized benchmark fixtures from failed trajectories.
STEP 2 - DIAGNOSE: run `harness-cycle --action diagnose --stage all --trials 2 --json` to classify the failure modes across Context, Sub-Agents, Tools, and Scaffolding.
STEP 3 - VERIFY SUITE: run `harness-eval --action suites --stage all --json` to confirm suite coverage across Stage 1 and Stage 2 roles.
context.prior_learnings: Sanitize all credentials, emails, and project identifiers before writing harvested tasks to disk.

responsibilities.name: Autonomous Loop B and Loop A Continuous Repository Improvement
responsibilities.instruction: Execute the unified Loop B + Loop A closed-loop harness optimization cycle on the GCP lab environment. Harvest failed and retried trajectories into sanitized regression fixtures, expand the benchmark curriculum for saturated roles, evaluate all active roles with the Frontier Model Committee, evolve single-lens candidates under the Capability-First Credo, and open verified pull requests against the primary repository.
responsibilities.success_criteria: Repository surface invariants passed, failed trajectories were harvested and saturated roles received harder curriculum tasks, Frontier Model Committee baseline and candidate scores were computed across active roles, capability-first lexicographic selection verified zero capability regression, and any Pareto-dominant winner was applied to a promotion branch with a pull request report.

context.purpose: Ensure the primary Paraclete repository continuously improves the job capability, reliability, and efficiency of every deployed role while expanding skill and role coverage as existing benchmarks saturate.
process: STEP 1 - VALIDATE: run `harness-cycle --action validate --repo . --json` to confirm the candidate repository checkout respects all immutable spine boundaries and contract bounds.

STEP 2 - LOOP B HARVEST & CURRICULUM: run `harness-eval --action harvest --stage all --expand-curriculum --persist --json` to turn recent failures into regression fixtures and synthesize harder tasks for roles at or above 0.98 capability.

STEP 3 - COMMITTEE BASELINE & DIAGNOSIS: run `harness-eval --action evaluate --stage all --trials 2 --live --judge-committee --include-harvested --json` and `harness-cycle --action diagnose --stage all --trials 2 --live --judge-committee --json`.

STEP 4 - LOOP A EVOLUTION: run `harness-cycle --action run --stage all --iterations 2 --candidates 2 --trials 2 --live --vertex --judge-committee --include-harvested --expand-curriculum --json` to evolve and score candidates under the Capability-First Credo.

STEP 5 - PROMOTE TO PRIMARY REPO: run `harness-promote --action verify --repo . --stage all --trials 2 --live --vertex --judge-committee --apply --push-pr --json` to verify all gates and open a pull request on the primary repository.
context.prior_learnings: Capability scored by the Frontier Model Committee (`vertex-google/gemini-4-argon` and `vertex-anthropic/claude-opus-5-5`) overrides all other metrics. Never accept a candidate with any capability regression, and only optimize reliability or efficiency when capability is strictly improved or preserved.
